manual_reason: Since 2025 Equinor distributes Volve through Databricks Marketplace (listing by Equinor ASA), which needs a free Databricks account; you accept the Equinor Open Data Licence when you get the data. Download the WITSML realtime drilling zip there and import it with owd.import_data("volve", path). The data may be shared but not sold. Checked 4 Nov 2026.

process.note: Each WITSML 1.4 log is read whole from the zip (units and nulls from its own header) and standardized; logs with fewer than 2 standard channels are skipped. Logs with an undeclared unit on a known channel are not guessed: they are listed in _failures.json.
